title: Luca Negotiates (Sit)
youtubeTitle: Luca vs. The Treat: Teaching Sit (Puppy Training Tips)

scenes.shot: Wide. Luca sits facing a human's legs (shoulders down only) holding a treat. Slow push-in on his face.
scenes.voiceover: The human is holding a snack. Clearly it's a gift.

scenes.shot: Close-up. Luca lets out a huge dramatic sigh, cheeks puffing.
scenes.voiceover: Why is she not giving it?

scenes.shot: Medium. Luca jumps at her leg, then slides down, paws scrabbling. Nothing happens.
Medium. Luca spins, barks, does a play bow. The treat does not move.
scenes.voiceover: I've offered my best moves. The human seems unimpressed.

scenes.shot: Close-up. The treat rises slowly over his head. His eyes follow and his head tips back.
Low angle. His bottom drops to the floor by accident. The hand gives him the treat.
Quick cuts. Luca sits smugly in the kitchen, the bathroom, and in front of the fridge, waiting each time.
Close-up. Smug face, slow head tilt toward camera.

scenes.heading: How to teach Sit
steps: Hold a treat at his nose, then move it slowly up and back over his head.
The moment his bottom touches the floor, say "Yes!" and give the treat.
After a few reps, say "sit" just before the lure.
Keep sessions to 3 to 5 minutes. Puppies tire quickly.
Practice in different rooms so he learns it everywhere.
